title: 「Only after ... did ...」倒裝句

omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 220; it is assigned system ID ss221 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: Only after + event/action + did + subject + base verb + other information

formulas.formula: Only after + subject + verb + did + subject + base verb
Only after + V-ing + did + subject + base verb
Only after + noun phrase + did + subject + base verb

example: Only after the report was published did the public understand the scale of the problem.
exampleZh: 只有在報告發表之後，大眾才明白問題的規模。

examples.en: Only after the report was published did the public understand the scale of the problem.
examples.zh: 只有在報告發表之後，大眾才明白問題的規模。
examples.highlight: Only after the report was published did the public understand the scale of the problem.

meaning.zh: 這個句型表示某件事情必須先發生，另一件事情才發生、才變得可能，或某人才獲得某種理解。

rules.zh: 倒裝只出現在主句 Only after 後面的部分使用正常語序。 Correct: Only after the report was published did the public understand the problem. （只有在報告發表之後，大眾才明白這個問題。） Incorrect: Only after was the report published did the public understand the problem. ✗ after 後面的子句應該是： the report was published 而不是： was the report published
rules.en: Use inversion only in the main clause. The clause after Only after keeps normal word order: “the report was published”, not “was the report published”.

rules.zh: 主句使用 did + 主語 + 原形動詞 普通語序： The public understood the problem. 倒裝語序： did the public understand the problem 加入 did 後，主要動詞必須使用原形。 Correct: Only after the report was published did the public understand the problem. Incorrect: Only after the report was published did the public understood the problem. ✗
rules.en: Form the main clause with did + subject + base verb. After did, use understand rather than understood.

rules.zh: 放在主語之前 Correct: Only after the rain stopped did the children go outside. Incorrect: Only after the rain stopped the children did go outside. ✗ 倒裝部分必須是： did + the children + go
rules.en: Place did before the subject: “did the children go”, not “the children did go” in this target inversion.

rules.zh: 這套練習集中使用過去式 本課所有答案均使用： Only after … did … 因此，主要動作發生在過去。 如談論現在或將來，可能需要使用 do、does、can、will 等其他助動詞，但這些形式不屬於本課的 主要目標。
rules.en: This exercise focuses on past-time inversion with Only after ... did .... Other auxiliaries may be required for present or future meanings, but they are outside this lesson.

rules.zh: 表示「之前沒有，之後才有」 Only after A did B 的意思不只是： A happened before B. 而是： B did not happen before A. 例如： Only after the teacher gave an example did Olivia understand the question. （只有在老師舉例之後，奧莉花才明白這條問題。） 這句暗示奧莉花在老師舉例之前並不明白。
rules.en: Only after A did B means that B did not happen before A. It expresses more than ordinary chronological order.

rules.zh: 不要把普通的先後次序強行改成這個句型 以下句子只說明兩件事情先後發生： Leo ate dinner and then watched television. （里奧吃過晚餐，然後看電視。） 它不一定表示里奧在吃晚餐之前不能或不會看電視，因此未必適合改成 Only after。 題目必須清楚表達「直到……之後才……」的意思。
rules.en: Do not force this structure onto an ordinary sequence. Use it only when the prompt clearly means that the later event did not happen until after the earlier event.

benefits.zh: 清楚強調事情發生的先後條件 這個句型不只是告訴讀者哪件事情先發生，還清楚表示第一件事情是第二件事情發生前的重要 條件。 Only after the final check did the doctor allow the patient to leave. （只有在完成最後檢查後，醫生才容許病人離開。） 讀者可以立即知道，病人在完成檢查之前不能離開。
benefits.en: It clearly emphasises the earlier event as a condition for what happened later.

benefits.zh: 把最重要的轉捩點放在句首 使用 Only after 開始句子，可以先把讀者的注意力放在重要的原因、條件或轉捩點上。 普通語序： The company admitted its mistake only after the evidence was published. 倒裝語序： Only after the evidence was published did the company admit its mistake. 第二句更強調「證據公開」是令公司承認錯誤的關鍵。
benefits.en: It puts the most important turning point first and directs attention to the event that caused the change.

benefits.zh: 讓事件之間的關係更清楚 與其只寫兩個分開的句子，這個句型能把較早和較遲發生的事情連接起來。 The alarm was repaired. The building became quiet. 這兩句只表示兩件事情發生了。 Only after the alarm was repaired did the building become quiet. （只有在警鐘修好後，大樓才回復安靜。） 新句子清楚表達兩件事情之間的關係。
benefits.en: It clarifies the relationship between two events instead of merely listing them as separate facts.

benefits.zh: 提供另一種句子開頭 學生經常使用： Then… After that… Finally… The company… The students… 使用 Only after 可以改變句子的開頭，令文章不會連續出現相同的主語加動詞結構。
benefits.en: It provides another sentence opening and reduces repetition of Then, After that, Finally or subject-first clauses.

benefits.zh: 適合強調遲來的理解、發現或行動 這個句型特別適合描述某人經過一件事情後，才： understood something 明白某事 realised something 意識到某事 discovered something 發現某事 recognised a problem 察覺問題 took action 採取行動 changed a decision 改變決定
benefits.en: It is especially useful for delayed understanding, discoveries, recognition, decisions and action.

benefits.zh: 令正式寫作更有層次 這個句型常見於故事、新聞報道、報告、論說文及較正式的解釋。 它能幫助學生準確表達事件的發展，而不只是把事情逐件列出。 不過，這是一種帶有強調作用的句式，不需要在每一個表示先後次序的句子中使用。
benefits.en: It gives stories, reports, essays and formal explanations a more structured and emphatic style.

en: Begin with Only after and use an inverted main clause with did.
Preserve the meaning, subject, tense, object, negation and other details; use the base verb after did.
zh: 把 Only after 放在句首，並在主句使用 did 倒裝改寫每題。
保留原句意思、主語、時態、受詞、否定意思及其他重要資料；did 後使用原形動詞。
